checks.text: A priced job with no wage yet offers "Ask for a wage" and no "Give it to someone else": it cannot be handed to a craftsman
A job whose wage is set (and is being made) can be handed on

shots.caption: A priced job whose wage is not set yet

notes: The same rule is also checked inside the system: asking to give a job out before its wage is set is refused with "Set the wages before you give the job to a craftsman". This has an automatic test.
did: Compared two jobs on the owner's page: one with a wage set, one still waiting for its wage.
